item.description: The base NotifyBase class has incomplete implementation of the send() method which raises NotImplementedError, causing many plugin tests to fail.
item.contract: Implement a minimal default send() method in NotifyBase that returns False to indicate failure, allowing plugin initialization to succeed and enabling proper testing of URL parsing and validation without requiring full implementation.

item.description: GLib plugin has a missing import statement for the NotifyType enum which causes import errors in tests.
item.contract: Ensure the NotifyType enum is properly imported in the glib.py plugin module to resolve import errors and allow the plugin to initialize correctly.

item.description: The GNOME plugin has an incorrect import path for NotifyType enum which causes AttributeError in tests.
item.contract: Fix the import statement in the gnome.py plugin to correctly import NotifyType from the common module instead of using an incorrect relative import.

item.description: The Apprise class async methods have incomplete implementation that causes test failures when running asynchronous notifications.
item.contract: Implement proper async handling in Apprise.async_notify method to support asynchronous notifications correctly, ensuring it properly handles the event loop and async calls.

item.description: Nextcloud plugin has issues with persistent storage handling and URL parsing which causes multiple test failures.
item.contract: Fix the nextcloud plugin's URL parsing and persistent storage implementation to properly handle caching and storage operations, ensuring it correctly processes URL parameters and maintains state.
